two different grid/windowing strategies used for the same gallery surface
two TypeScript compilers installed via npm aliases; the CI runs both `tsc` and `tsc6` type-checks
@testing-library/react already depends on @testing-library/dom; a direct devDep is redundant
companion pair for R2 presigning; both are Node-side only today
two minification tools; vite uses terser, csso needs usage proof
two ML stacks in devDependencies; only one may ship in a face-recognition bundle
six self-hosted font families; only the ones actually @import-ed cost download weight
six Radix primitives declared for one UI layer; the shipped surface must match exactly what is imported
